name: dsfd_wfc_vmx_p-p3-COMMIT
purpose: S81 sp_wfc priced kit (VM_LINK 1, POSTED 1, RD2 1, VMRQ 64, WOUTW 8, HEP): the VM / stage-core port tile = dsfd_wfc_vmx_w (WFC -> VM write / START transport) + dsfd_wfc_vmx_r (VM -> WFC prefetch / DONE, slow -> fast ratio FIFO at RDEPTH 4, staging buffer in two 1R1W macros) + dsfd_wfc_hep_t (issue-epoch table on one SRAM macro). One tile because the slot's die pins are all on its 328-um E face and the closed link bridge takes 151.2 um of it: 172.8 um is left for every VM / core / HEP pin. Two related clocks (ck 833.3 ps, ckv 4/3), each root <= 15k sinks. 0 cycles added: cycle-exact with the one-tile kit in the cluster lockstep bench.

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: the one-tile priced vmx (63k+ flops on one root; routes rq64w8 hold-stalled, rd2s TT -145.87) rebuilt: 32.8k-flop staging buffer -> two 1R1W macros behind a registered look-ahead, slow -> fast ratio FIFO depth 8 -> 4, HEP 2 x 13.3k-flop banks -> one SRAM macro with a 3-edge pipeline; ~26.5k flops over two roots (ck ~11.9k, ckv ~14.6k); p2: pin plan re-made after p1 crashed at IO placement (PPL-0093: 1,738 pins at 2 M4 tracks = 97 % of the 172.8-um E face): E face keeps the two wide buses t_swd / f_srq (1,553 pins, 86 %), the 185 narrow VM / core / HEP / fault pins leave on S at the E end (the die pins below y 43 of the slot's E face), balanced pin placer with per-port ranges; p3: regional FIFO read pointers (32bit groups f2s /64bit s2f, each mux driver <=256loads), one-hot local read successor removes binary increment/wrap from pin read-enable path without added cycles; related-root physical balancing from actual sequential clock-pin mean instead of mixed macro extrema, legalized at every buffer stage. Independent pointer reset/stall/phase scoreboard80 exact+2mutants and productionparent6exact+7mutants.; reset followup: serial link live flops consume domain-local srst_n, HEP release passes one two-flop serial-domain synchronizer before all quarter fanout; remove blanket reset false path, keep normal setup/hold/recovery/removal checks. Updated production6exact+7mutants and HEP200k-cycle exact+3mutants pass.
